Subject: Horizon Commerce — post-demo: procurement path & SOC2/pen test artifacts

Hi Asha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate your time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Buyers & approval path (we're missing one confirmation): please confirm the economic buyer and whether procurement will own contract execution or finance. From the demo it sounded like Mark Liu (CFO) will sign off on spend, and procurement owns vendor on-boarding — can you confirm?

2) Security/Procurement asks we can action immediately: SOC 2 report (Type II preferred), summary of pen test scope (we can provide a redacted manifest), sample audit logs for retention patterns, and data retention policy. We'll attach a SOC2 summary and a pen-test manifest stub to this thread. Full pen-test reports can be shared under NDA.

3) Timeline & gating items: you mentioned a 60–90 day procurement window. If we can get the procurement questionnaire and PO cadence this week, Marissa will prepare an SOW + pricing that fits your procurement cadence.

4) Decision criteria: please list the top 3 decision criteria your team is using (cost per 1k tokens, latency SLOs at p95, data residency/compliance). If you prefer, we can put a brief checklist for you to send to legal/security.

Attachments: SOC2_summary_v1.pdf (summary), pen-test-manifest.txt (scope & redaction notes)

Proposed next step: Can we lock a 30-minute procurement + security sync next Wed (Feb 17) to align on gating documents and signatures?

Thanks — I'll wait for the economic buyer and procurement contact confirmation and will queue the SOW.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive

Hi Jonas —

Great summary, thanks. Quick answers: 

- Economic buyer: Mark Liu (CFO) — will be the ultimate sign-off on spend over $75k.
- Procurement: procurement@horizoncommerce.com (cc'd) will handle vendor onboarding and PO templates. They usually need SOC 2 Type II (latest 12 months) and a brief pen-test scope; they accept redacted reports for initial review.
- Decision criteria (high level): 1) predictable per-token economics and billing transparency, 2) p95 latency under 300ms for our typical inference profile, 3) clear controls around data retention and audit logs.

Procurement asked: can you state whether you support a 7-year audit log retention export (we typically export to our long-term store)? Also, any data residency guarantees for US-only?

We can do the procurement/security sync on Wed Feb 17 — propose 10:00 PT. I'll add Mark to the invite once procurement confirms they have initial docs.

Thanks,
Asha Gupta
VP, Product

- Asha Gupta (Product) — product fit & SLO alignment.
- Tom Reynolds (Engineering/Platform) — technical owner for perf/security questions.
- Procurement (procurement@horizoncommerce.com) — legal/contracting and PO.

Procurement asks answered: 
- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report for the trailing 12 months. Attached is a one-page SOC2_summary_v1.pdf.
- Pen test: attached pen-test-manifest.txt outlines the scope and redaction approach; full reports are available under NDA — we can route that once procurement executes our standard NDA (we can share an NDA link or accept your template).
- Audit logs & retention: we can export audit logs in CSV/Parquet. Attached is an example audit-log-sample.csv showing event timestamps and action types. We support exports for up to 7 years if required — storage/export arrangements can be included in the SOW.
- Data residency: Hosted Redwood API endpoints for this contract will be in US regions only; for strict on-prem/VPC requirements we can discuss Redwood Private.
